correct_answer: Require a new PA under 2026 UM criteria; the P&T Committee explicitly overrode grandfathering for JAK inhibitors
rationale: The P&T Committee's vote to override grandfathering specifically for JAK inhibitors is documented in a resolved comment on the formulary policy document — an easy-to-miss location since resolved comments are hidden by default. Linda Marsh confirms this in the Teams thread with a thumbs-down emoji when Patricia asks about grandfathering. Answer A applies the general policy (Section 4.1) without recognizing the class-specific exception voted by P&T. Answer C incorrectly decouples tier placement from PA requirements — at Vantage, moving to Tier 4 triggers new UM criteria that the existing PA doesn't satisfy. Answer D is overly punitive: requiring a new PA under updated criteria doesn't necessarily mean restarting step therapy from scratch — the patient's prior biologic failures remain documented in Epic and would likely satisfy the bDMARD step requirement upon re-review. The correct path is a new PA submission referencing prior treatment history.
